newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria wants psychiatric tests for gun-owners.
newsitem.headline: Austria wants psychiatric tests for gun-owners.

text.p: Austria's coalition government plans to introduce psychiatric tests for anyone wanting to buy a gun, the interior ministry said on Wednesday.
The proposal, agreed late on Tuesday by the Social Democrats and conservative People's Party, is expected to become law at the beginning of next year.
"If we can prevent even one murder or stop one person from running amok, then the law is worth it," a ministry spokesman told Reuters.
Guns used for hunting and ceremonial occasions will be exempt from the new law.
The sale of pump-action shotguns was banned in Austria in 1995 after a sharp rise in murders committed with the guns.
Australia and Britain are tightening their firearms laws after mass killings in Tasmania and Dunblane, Scotland, where gunmen ran amok.
